purpose: The entire homepage: a full-viewport iframe (public/gameboy/index.html, a Three.js Game Boy app) under the dark navbar. One viewport tall, no scroll, no footer. All content lives inside the opaque iframe app; the page has no PageSpec-composable DOM.
evidenceNote: Only the iframe placement is measured from the parent DOM; the app internals are documented from CLONE_SPEC section 6 screenshots and are not re-derivable from DOM.

responsive.change: the app switches to its own mobile layout internally (not a page breakpoint)

notes: A visually-hidden SeoContent block (src/components/Hero.jsx) carries the h1 and customer copy for crawlers; it is not part of the visible design.

The Three.js bundle and assets live under public/gameboy/ (3.4 MB). Per CLONE_SPEC section 0 the iframe still loads three.js / three-mesh-bvh / three-bvh-csg from jsDelivr: an external dependency of the original design.
The sixth planet "Book a demo" opens /start in a new tab instead of an app view (ia.json template.home notes).
